paper_title: CAPSTONE Curriculum Sampling for Dense Retrieval with Document   Expansion
caption: Results of DPR with corpus, document, and asymmetric expansion on the dev set of MS-Marco.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) values for four different DPR configurations during inference, as a function of the number of queries used. The x-axis, labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)," displays a linear scale ranging from 2 to 10, with tick labels spaced by increments of 2. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” utilizes a linear scale extending from approximately 33.0 to 36.5, with values marked every 0.5. The black line represents DPR w/ query, starting at approximately 35.1 and declining to approximately 34.3. The red line represents DPR w/ corpus expansion, beginning at approximately 35.6 and decreasing to approximately 35.0. The green line represents DPR w/ document expansion, beginning at approximately 34.9 and decreasing to approximately 34.3. Finally, the blue line represents DPR w/ asymmetric expansion, starting at approximately 34.1 and decreasing to approximately 33.7.
